source_spans.title: Start with the definition catalog
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Department administrators use record definitions to give authors a consistent form and lifecycle. In Records, open Manage and choose Definitions. This example builds a department-owned form for a fictional community coordination exercise.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries; initial0.000–0.070 static visual pre-roll only, not an estimated speech onset.

source_spans.title: Start with the definition catalog
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The catalog separates published and draft versions. A definition describes the form; an individual record stores one completed entry. Choose New definition for the new exercise, leaving the product-owned forms unchanged.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Create a distinct blank definition
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Start from template is set to Blank definition. Give Definition a unique lower-case key, then enter the Name and Category. Here the name is Training Only, Community Software Exercise, and the category is Academy Software Exercises. The key cannot be changed after creation, so review it before choosing Create definition.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Create a distinct blank definition
required_labels: Definition created. Edit the schema, validate, then publish.
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The returned editor identifies version one as Draft and confirms that the definition was created. It is not yet a published form.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Choose a lifecycle and numbering policy
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Lifecycle preset is QuickEntry, supporting a draft followed by finalization. Records per call is Multiple per call. Require author attestation at finalize is checked; reviewer and approver roles are not selected for this example.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Choose a lifecycle and numbering policy
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Under Numbering, Number prefix gives record numbers a recognizable label. Sequence width is four and Assign number is OnFinalize. Reset yearly is checked, while the station and incident sequence options are off. These choices provide one annual sequence for this definition and issue the number when the record is finalized, rather than when its draft first appears.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Review fields, classification and client choices
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Classification is Standard. In Client surfaces, only Responder is selected. Allow offline is off, Allow attachments is on, and Keep photo coordinates on attachments is off. Together, these choices control where the form is offered, whether it can be used offline, and whether authors can attach files.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Review fields, classification and client choices
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The Fields table describes the unchanged starter form: Summary is required ShortText, while Notes is optional LongText. A short summary helps identify an entry; longer notes provide its context. Check that table rather than mistaking the nearby JSON example for the saved form.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Keep validation and saving distinct

source_spans.title: Keep validation and saving distinct

source_spans.title: Read the saved draft identity
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The returned record is Draft, with a draft reference and no final record number. Author and Owner are Wallace Boden. Station and group resolves to Command, although the new form showed None. Read the saved result rather than assuming that a blank selection remained blank. Keep this reference so later editing and attachment work stay with the same record.

source_spans.exact_narration_span: Use Edit on this draft instead of opening another New Record form.

source_spans.title: Edit and reopen the same draft
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Update Notes to explain that the summary and public handout were reviewed in the fictional exercise. Read the complete statement in the editor, then use Save draft.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Edit and reopen the same draft
source_spans.exact_narration_span: A fresh readback of the same reference contains those revised Notes and remains Draft. The separate readback is the check that the intended text was retained.

source_spans.exact_narration_span: On the saved record, Attachments provides Choose Files, File classification and Add attachment.

source_spans.title: Add the handout from the saved record
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Choose the public software handout and select Unrestricted operational content, then use Add attachment. This choice is for that file; it is separate from the form’s Standard classification.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Add the handout from the saved record
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The fresh list contains the software handout, with a size of two hundred forty-two bytes. The next-upload selector has reset to Restricted. That reset does not describe the file already stored; check its retained metadata in the finalized revision.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Attest and verify the issued number
required_labels: I attest that this record is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Read the saved Summary and Notes before checking the accuracy attestation and choosing Finalize.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Attest and verify the issued number
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The fresh result shows Finalized. Its number uses our T R N A D M prefix, the year twenty twenty-six, and the four-digit sequence zero zero zero one. The draft reference remains alongside it. Amend is available for a later correction to a finalized record.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Inspect the retained revision and attachment
source_spans.exact_narration_span: History now shows revision one, Finalized, with the author and date. The handout remains listed. Use View on that history row.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Inspect the retained revision and attachment
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The resulting HTML revision identifies the same record. Its attachment metadata retains the filename, byte size, checksum and Unrestricted classification. The checksum matches the public handout. This is the stored classification, independent of the reset upload selector.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Inspect the retained revision and attachment
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Farther down, Values preserves the saved Summary and Notes alongside the draft reference and record number. Review this specific revision when checking what finalization retained.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Reconcile the record queue
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Back in Records, the new custom row is Finalized. The three earlier records remain present: an Amended Training entry, a Work Draft and the older Finalized Training entry. Read Record number, Type, State and Summary together to choose the intended row. This record-entry sequence created only its own custom entry; finding it again does not require creating a replacement.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.exact_narration_span: For later use, return to the definition catalog. The department-owned row shows published version one, no draft version, and its own New Record control. Use that row to select the intended form.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Find the right form through its catalog row
required_labels: New Record — TRAINING ONLY - Community software exercise
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The actual launcher opens the named version-one form with Summary and Notes. This later check leaves the new form empty.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Find the right form through its catalog row
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Returning to the queue still shows four records, with no second custom draft.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Apply the pattern to your department
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Fire and EMS teams can use a small form for exercise briefings. Community-care and mental-health teams can standardize coordination notes with suitable information rules. Search-and-rescue teams can organize mission-preparation summaries. Security teams can structure patrol briefings, wildland coordinators can prepare seasonal orientation forms, and industrial teams can retain system-training notes and a public handout.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual service SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Apply the pattern to your department
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Across those settings, choose fields, numbering and client access for the task. Test the actual published form, verify the saved draft and attachment, and retain the finalized revision that supports the entry.
